# Atomic Policy Statements — Test Reference
# These statements should pass through the atomizer UNCHANGED.

# AC-3: Single obligation with "must"
All systems must enforce MFA
→ Expected: 1 atomic requirement (unchanged)

# AC-4: Single obligation with "must"
Passwords must be at least 12 characters
→ Expected: 1 atomic requirement (unchanged)

# EC-1: "and" without normative verb after conjunction
Systems must encrypt and store data securely
→ Expected: 1 atomic requirement (unchanged — "and" not followed by normative verb)

# EC-5: Non-splitting "and" in object phrase
Systems must implement logging and monitoring
→ Expected: 1 atomic requirement (unchanged)

# EC-10: Uppercase normative verbs (case-sensitive, no match)
Systems MUST enforce MFA and MUST require passwords
→ Expected: 1 atomic requirement (unchanged — case-sensitive matching)
